title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
snippet: Optio is an open-source orchestration system that turns tickets into merged pull requests using AI coding agents. You point it at your repos, and it handles the full lifecycle: Intake, Execution, PR monitoring, Self-healing, and Completion (squash-merge).

title: Copilot-reviewed pull request merge metrics now in the usage metrics API
snippet: GitHub added metrics for 'Copilot-reviewed' PRs, including median time to merge. This signals that GitHub is explicitly tracking and validating the AI-review-to-merge pipeline.

title: The Great Claude Code Leak of 2026: KAIROS Autonomous Mode
snippet: Mentions KAIROS, an unreleased autonomous background daemon mode for Claude Code that runs background sessions, executes autoDream for nightly memory consolidation, and converts observations into verified facts.

title: AgenticFlict: Merge Conflicts in AI Coding Agent Pull Requests
snippet: A dataset and study on merge conflicts specific to AI-generated PRs, highlighting the friction in the autonomous merge process.

title: garrytan/land-and-deploy
snippet: Mentions a tool to 'Merge the PR, wait for CI and deploy, verify production health'. Highly relevant to the autonomous deployment wedge.

title: CTO mandating AI coding + killing code reviews - how do you push back?
snippet: CTO is removing human code reviews in favor of AI coding agent throughput. Developers are struggling with how to maintain quality and accountability. This is the ultimate 'Signer Gap' incident.

title: Your AI Agent Has More Access Than Your Employees
snippet: Highlights the risk of agents running with developer-level AWS credentials in production environments due to configuration sprawl and tight deadlines.

title: Show HN: I made a cheaper alternative to Claude Code or Codex CLI
snippet: Sweet! CLI features 'autopilot' for monitoring live deployed applications and detecting outages to triage immediately, with agents deployed to production servers.
